rows.ARS:
Light yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Something Special (hybrid tea, McGredy, 1991)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1991).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 1999 as 'Something Special'.
Introduced by Unknown (New Zealand) in before 2000 as 'Paul Holmes'.
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2001 as 'Forum'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow . Flowers pale yellow with hints of apricot and peach. Creamy amber lemon blend. Mild fragrance. Small to medium, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' to 42" (90 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, exhibition or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Breeder's notes: Paul Holmes - Macwyom. Nicknamed Wyoming. For the TV presenter
